_comment: Single source of truth for public project status. tools/status.py generates the README and website roadmaps from this file; CI fails if they drift (audit M-04, L-04). States: done | active | upcoming.

phases.name: Specification
phases.note: consensus drafts v0.3-v0.5 (transactions v0.5), P2P and wallet (v0.3) drafts; frozen before mainnet

phases.name: Threat model
phases.note: living threat register mapped to tests (registers/threats.md)

phases.name: Simulation
phases.note: issuance, difficulty and capacity models; economic attack simulations still to do

phases.name: Prototype
phases.note: Python prototype and an independent spec-only verifier agree on every test vector

phases.name: Reference implementation
phases.note: Rust node and miner with encrypted wallet and public API, Strata wallet, Varvescan explorer; battle-tested, continuously fuzzed, built for Windows, macOS and Linux

phases.name: Testnets
phases.note: testnet genesis fixed (Bitcoin blocks 973,970-973,975); software ready; opens with its first seed node

phases.name: Independent review
phases.note: independent human protocol review and AI-assisted code reviews done (audits/); named independent security audit pending (see the mainnet readiness page)
